description: Verify an A2A payment authorization (apt_) before doing paid work. Answers validity, amount, caller_did and target_agent_did. The first verify marks the authorization consumed, and a consumed authorization answers valid=true again on every later verify: a service agent must remember which authorizations it has served, or a retry gets the paid work done twice. Requires agent JWT (any agent: the authorization carries the authority).

expected_target_did.description: Optional: expected target DID for extra check

token.description: The payment authorization's code (apt_) to verify

name: theprotocol_verifyPayment
title: Verify Payment
